title.narrative: Entry Points for Advancing Regional Security and Cooperation in the Gulf (and Beyond)

description.narrative: The overall aim of the project is to contribute to improving regional security in the wider Gulf region. It establishes regional formats to promote confidence-building and cooperation, to develop options to enhancing channels of communication and to design mechanisms to prevent escalation and increase coordination in relation to maritime security and disaster response.
